card.name: Titles and names before a bracketed name
card.fires_on: Fires on the last word of a title or a metabolite name just before a personal name, a comma, an opening bracket or an equals sign. It appears in Cambodian news lists of officials and in zidovudine and similar drug-label text.

modes.label: Official titles before names
modes.description: Title words or name starts inside lists of Cambodian officials, right before the person's name.
modes.example: Royal Palace<< Minister>> Kong Samol and Senate Vice President Say

modes.label: Metabolite or abbreviation introducers
modes.description: A comma, bracket or equals sign after a drug or metabolite name where an abbreviation or alternate name follows.

card.writes: It promotes punctuation that opens a bracket or dash, and suppresses Chinese-style name tokens such as Wang.
card.plain: It marks the point right before a name or abbreviation is about to be given, after a title or a drug name.
